notes_and_instructions: How to use: 1) Sort by Signal Score then Renewal Runway to find high-risk near-term renewals. 2) Signal Score combines usage trend, billing events, support volume, exec changes (internal formula: usage*0.4 + billing*0.25 + support*0.2 + exec*0.15). 3) Mark Escalation Needed = yes only if cross-team action required (finance/legal/eng/security). 4) Update Last Touchpoint after each outreach. 5) Move accounts with confirmed renewals to the closed worksheet in Confluence (CS-Closed-Renewals).
